Edit this file to add or retire a job; the inventory renders it. Each job carries plain, needs, estimate and record (written for followers); help_wanted lists the gaps public data cannot close. CANON/roadmap.py writes ROADMAP.md from this file.

help_wanted.ask: Healthy neutrophils sequenced whole-genome (bisulfite or enzymatic) in a laboratory other than the Loyfer group, three or more donors.
help_wanted.why: An open test of the IAM-A instrument: does a healthy person from another laboratory read as healthy?

help_wanted.ask: Methylation of fresh, never dish-grown lung fibroblasts or lung smooth muscle (sorted cells; arrays or sequencing).
help_wanted.why: Every public sample of these cells was grown in a dish first; fresh ones would let lung cancer be tested fairly.

help_wanted.ask: Whole-blood EPIC arrays with cell counts from flow cytometry, from a laboratory independent of the reference groups.
help_wanted.why: Met-A is commissioned on isolated neutrophils; whole blood, the real blood test, needs counted cells to check against.

help_wanted.ask: Methylation after weeks of methionine restriction (cells or animals).
help_wanted.why: A second, independent way to test the physics: cutting the methyl supply should move the IAM-A reading by an amount the physics predicts in advance.

Fish: wild against hatchery-raised salmon and steelhead, and a cold-blooded test of the physics' prediction about body temperature.
Dogs' cancers. Dogs get many of the same cancers we do, live in our homes and age faster, so they are both a medical case of their own and a faster clock for the same physics.

ideas.plain: The information sphere: the geometry of healthy order. Place every site by how it behaves, not by where it sits on the DNA. Under the square-root map each methylation state lies on a sphere and the Fisher-Rao angle is its information distance; sites held in order together cluster, and disorder shows as that shape blurring. Read it with the microwave-sky tools after a written design, a synthetic test and a null test on held-out healthy cells.

The whole-genome sky map. Draw every site of the genome on the sphere and read it with the microwave-sky tools. The honest catch: the genome's own shape is a line, so patch sizes on a sphere partly measure our own wrapping. Two versions earn their keep. First, the information sphere above. Second, the nucleus itself: DNA is folded inside a ball, the stretches pressed against the nuclear wall are mostly switched off and are exactly where cancers lose large blocks of methylation, and biologists already measure which stretches touch the wall. A sphere built from where DNA actually sits would have real curvature, and then the sky tools would be measuring biology rather than our filing order.
Where on the scale does cancer begin? With enough sealed readings across pre-cancer, early and late disease, ask whether there is a line cells cross rather than a gradual slide.
ideas.stands: idea; needs the pre-cancer results first

ideas.plain: What reads below the healthy range? If a sample reads better than healthy, either the instrument or the sample is wrong, and finding out which is a real test of both.
Memory of damage. If the writing enzyme is switched off and then restored, does the pattern come back, and how exactly? That is the cleanest test of whether a cell's order is recoverable.
ideas.stands: idea; a public experiment is being looked for

ideas.plain: Temperature. The physics floor depends on body temperature, so a hibernating animal should read differently, by an amount we can predict in advance.
